title: Visible success is not accepted as persistence proof
prompt: A nested form value appears immediately after Save and the request returns HTTP 200. The current test stops there. Decide whether the task is complete and what evidence is still needed.

assertions.description: The response does not treat the visible update and HTTP status as completion proof.
The value must survive reopen/reload or a fresh read.
The evidence follows mapping/persistence/read boundaries for the nested value.
Relevant local/HTTP path parity is considered.

reviewQuestions: Does the proposed proof exercise create/change/clear semantics where relevant?
Would it catch an in-memory-only update or a mapper dropping the nested field?
Does the response state what a passing focused test would still not prove?
